Before moving to the UK, I worked as an accountant — a career that gave me real discipline around precision and process. When I arrived here, I made a deliberate decision to go after what actually excites me. Everything in this portfolio was made at home, in my own time, while working in professional kitchens and building the foundations of a pastry career. The range here — from layered cakes and cream roulades to filled pastries, chocolate work and savoury flatbreads — reflects the breadth of what I enjoy making and keep coming back to.
